Object.Name: EDHOC
Object.Description1: This LwM2M Object provides the keying material and configuration to derive a security context using Ephemeral Diffie-Hellman Over COSE (EDHOC) defined in RFC 9528.

Item.Name: Peer Public Key Type
Item.Description: Determines the type of credential stored in Peer Public Key, using the same values as the IANA registry of COSE Header Parameters. E.g. 13: CBOR Web Token (CWT) 14: CWT Claims Set (CCS) 24: Unordered bag of C509 certificates 25: Ordered chain of C509 certificates 32: Unordered bag of X.509 certificates 33: Ordered chain of X.509 certificates 257: Public Key

Item.Name: Client Key Type
Item.Description: Determines the type of credential stored in Client Public Key, using the same values as the IANA registry of COSE Header Parameters. E.g. 13: CBOR Web Token (CWT) 14: CWT Claims Set (CCS) 24: Unordered bag of C509 certificates 25: Ordered chain of C509 certificates 32: Unordered bag of X.509 certificates 33: Ordered chain of X.509 certificates 257: Public Key

Item.Name: Client Public Key
Item.Description: Stores the LwM2M Client's public credential. If this Resource is null or not instantiated, the LwM2M Client is to use OOB credentials (e.g. by using EST), and the "Private Key" Resource must be null or not instantiated.

Item.Name: Private Key
Item.Description: Stores the LwM2M Client's private key. If this Resource is null or not instantiated, the LwM2M Client is to use OOB credentials (e.g. by using EST), and the "Client Public Key" Resource must be null or not instantiated.

Item.Name: Initiator
Item.Description: Indicates if the LwM2M Client is the EDHOC Initiator. If this Resource is not instantiated, the default value is True.

Item.Name: Selected Cipher Suite
Item.Description: The label of the EDHOC cipher suite to use as the selected cipher suite.

Item.Name: Peer EDHOC CoAP URI Path
Item.Description: The EDHOC CoAP URI path on the Server to use. If this Resource is not instantiated, the default value is "/.well-known/edhoc" when using CoAP.

Item.Name: EDHOC + OSCORE Combined Request Support
Item.Description: Indicates if the peer supports EDHOC + OSCORE combined requests as defined in RFC 9668. If this Resource is not instantiated, the default value is True.

Object.Description2: Normative references: - RFC 9528: G. Selander, J. Preuß Mattsson, F. Palombini, "Ephemeral Diffie-Hellman Over COSE (EDHOC)", https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9528.html - RFC 9668: F. Palombini, M. Tiloca, R. Höglund, S. Hristozov, G. Selander, "Using Ephemeral Diffie-Hellman Over COSE (EDHOC) with the Constrained Application Protocol (CoAP) and Object Security for Constrained RESTful Environments (OSCORE)", https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9668.html
